thread.title: SouthernMED Pediatrics Brings Full-Day Pediatric Care to North Augusta with Integration of NiteOwl
thread.title_full: SouthernMED Pediatrics Brings Full-Day Pediatric Care to North Augusta with Integration of NiteOwl

author: 24-7 Press
title: SouthernMED Pediatrics Brings Full-Day Pediatric Care to North Augusta with Integration of NiteOwl
text:
NORTH AUGUSTA, SC, December 03, 2025 /24-7PressRelease/ — SouthernMED Pediatrics, one of South Carolina’s leading pediatric healthcare providers, proudly announces the addition of NiteOwl Pediatric Urgent Care, effective November 17, 2025. Located at 616 Edgefield Road, Suite 180, North Augusta, the practice will become SouthernMED Pediatrics + NiteOwl Extended Hours and will continue to serve families through the end of the year with its existing services and operating hours, providing trusted after-hours pediatric care to the growing North Augusta community.
Beginning January 2026, the practice will expand its scope of services and operating hours, transitioning to offer primary pediatric care and additional daytime business hours, along with the extended evening and weekend availability. This enhancement allows both established and new patient families to access comprehensive, full-day pediatric services in one convenient location.
“We could not be more excited about NiteOwl joining the SouthernMED family of practices,” said Dr. R. Kyle Guyton, MD, FAAP, Co-Founder of SouthernMED Pediatrics. “With a strong presence already in the Aiken area, we’ve witnessed the continued growth of surrounding regions and the increasing need for high-quality pediatric providers. By expanding service hours and access to care, we are setting a new standard for family-centered pediatric services in North Augusta.”
Under the continued leadership of Carlee Leopard, SouthernMED Pediatrics + NiteOwl Extended Hours will shift its hours in early January to Monday through Thursday, 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM; Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM; Saturday, 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM; and Sunday, 11:00 AM to 4:00 PM.
This marks SouthernMED’s entry into North Augusta, one of South Carolina’s fastest-growing regions, and makes it one of only two dedicated pediatric practices in the city. The North Augusta location will strengthen SouthernMED’s statewide network of pediatric and adolescent medicine services, offering telemedicine, behavioral health integration, online appointment scheduling, and coordinated family communication tools to support patients across every stage of childhood.
SouthernMED has begun accepting appointments for primary care and well visits at this location starting in January. For additional details on SouthernMED Pediatrics and its mission to deliver comprehensive, family-centered pediatric care to medically underserved communities, please visit www.southernmedpeds.com .
About SouthernMED Pediatrics
SouthernMED Pediatrics has been a trusted leader in pediatric healthcare for families across South Carolina for more than 15 years. Founded by Dr. Kyle Guyton and Dr. Joseph Delaney, the practice began with a single location in Lexington in 2008 and has grown steadily through a shared vision of expanding access to high-quality pediatric care. Today, SouthernMED operates fifteen offices statewide and remains committed to reaching more medically underserved communities across South Carolina. As part of US Pediatric Partners , SouthernMED continues its mission to redefine pediatric excellence through a patient-first, team-driven model of care that prioritizes access, compassion, and innovation in every community it serves.
